note: A warm-up (DayShape2): part 2 of the guitar warm-up run, picked by its kind and never for a path step. The picking hand's warm-up, on open strings so the fretting hand rests; it shares the run's second part with the spider.

exercise.title: Down-up picking on the open strings
exercise.why: Picking down and then up plays two notes with one swing of the hand, so a short time on open strings sets that swing before the fretting hand joins in.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}. The tab under it shows each open string four times, from the low E string up to the high e string and back down. Pick down, up, down, up on each string: the arrows under the tab show the stroke for each note.
Keep going until your hand swings evenly, with no stop between the strokes.
